Zigzag Text Generator

Render your text in a diagonal zigzag (rail-fence) pattern — real ASCII art with adjustable rows and spacing.


    

      
    

  





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Type your text (short phrases work best).
  2. Set the number of zigzag rows and the spacing between letters.
  3. Copy the ASCII-art result from the preview box.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What is a zigzag pattern?
The letters bounce diagonally between rows like a "W" repeated — the same layout as the rail-fence cipher, rendered as fixed-width ASCII art.
Why does my long text look cramped?
Zigzag art needs horizontal room. Use fewer rows, shorter text, or copy it into a wider area (a code block or document).
Does it work with any characters?
Yes — letters, digits and symbols all follow the zigzag path. Emoji may misalign because they are wider than one column.
